messages.author: 6d704ab243307362
messages.subject: Error;  running Netlogo from R
parts:
I am trying to load and run a netlogo model from studio.
all Nl commands  (such as NLstart, NLLoad, NLcommand) are returning errors: "There is no NetLogo reference stored under the name".

i tried resolving the issue of NLstart by using the below code:
setwd("C:/Program Files/NetLogo 6.0.2")
url = 'https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/RNetLogo/RNetLogo_1.0-0.tar.gz'
install.packages(url, repos=NULL, type="source")
library("RNetLogo")
nl.path <- "C:/Program Files/NetLogo 6.0.2"
NLStart(nl.path)
and it worked

i tried resolving the NLLOad issue by using the below code:
path <- "C:/Users/Anthony/exp1.nlogo"
command <- paste("open netlogo", path)
system(command)
and it worked

i still have the issue of NLcommad for runig the model and exporting the outputs to excel. that is usually coded as below:
NLCommand("setup", nl.obj=my.netlogo) 
NLCommand("go", nl.obj=my.netlogo) 
NLCommand('export-world "setup.csv" ', nl.obj=my.netlogo) 
but is still giving me the error: 
  There is no NetLogo reference stored under the name exp1.nlogo

thank you
